channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrei Kirilenko | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrei Kirilenko from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Egor Demin on Andrei Kirilenko, Alexey Shved
item.description:
“Obviously, everybody knows about Andrei Kirilenko, the legend of Russian basketball. A lot more Russian legends that got to the NBA, and even though maybe they didn’t spend as much time in the NBA as they wanted to, they had great careers back in Russia in EuroLeague and became legends. And I was growing up looking up to Alexey Shved, playing in Khimki, and he was in the NBA, too. “So for me, all these players are a huge example and learning resource.”

Egor Demin on Andrei Kirilenko, Alexey Shved, Jun 24, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tony Allen on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
“I ain’t seeing KD. I’m just not seeing all that. I’m seeing Andrei Kirilenko.“He’s going to be a one-time All-Star. I don’t see it, bro. I’m just not hyped on these Duke kids. He is nice, but his max-out potential is Andrei Kirilenko.”

Tony Allen on Andrei Kirilenko, May 24, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andrei Kirilenko, Baron Davis
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Stephen Curry on his big yell late in the game:

“It's a different vibe when you know the game has consequences and means something. ... Shout out to Baron Davis. I definitely channeled my Kirilenko moment.”

Stephen Curry on Andrei Kirilenko, Baron Davis, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Luka Samanic on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Samanic on who he compares to as a player:

“Right now I think KD. A big guy who can shoot, who can play facing the basket, low post. But all the time, maybe (Andrei) Kirilenko. He played in Utah. I can run and jump and play defense. Just whatever it takes.”

Luka Samanic on Andrei Kirilenko, Jun 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Hollins on Kirilenko:

“I make choices and that’s the way we go. It’s life. I just go with what’s out there and who is getting the job done.”

Lionel Hollins on Andrei Kirilenko, Nov 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @nydninternets.

item.title: LeBron James on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
“He flopped a few times and he got the call. I thought the last one that fouled me out, that could've been a charge for sure. He was trying to put his hands on me as I drove and that's' what got him off balance and he was able to get the call. But Kirilenko flopped on me a couple of times.”

LeBron James on Andrei Kirilenko, Jan 11, 2014. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
James said he never heard the whistle for a subsequent offensive foul that had been called on him against Kirilenko, who was chasing James down as he drove to the rim.

“I thought Kirilenko flopped a few times, to be honest about it,”

LeBron James on Andrei Kirilenko, Jan 11, 2014. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
“We feel he's a valuable part of where we're going, and we'll do what we have to do to try to bring him back. I think Kirilenko's the same way. Until he exercises his option, we feel he's a guy that's going to come back.”

Flip Saunders on Andrei Kirilenko, May 29, 2013. Source: Fox Sports North.

item.title: Greg Miller on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Jazz CEOGreg Miller on tonight's Jazz game:

“I invite you to join me with warm applause in thanking Andrei for the yrs of play he gave us.”

Greg Miller on Andrei Kirilenko, Jan 2, 2013. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.

item.title: David Blatt on Andrei Kirilenko, Alexey Shved
item.description:
Russia coachDavid Blatt on Kirilenko & Shved vs. Team GB:

“If I'm the Minnesota Timberwolves ... I've got a big, fat smile on my face.”

David Blatt on Andrei Kirilenko, Alexey Shved, Jul 29, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Kahn on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
“We are pleased that Andrei has decided to resume his NBA career with the Minnesota Timberwolves,”

David Kahn on Andrei Kirilenko, Jul 27, 2012. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Kevin Love on Andrei Kirilenko, Brandon Roy, Chase Budinger
item.description:
“Actually, in the past few weeks I think they've done a great job. I like who we've added with Brandon Roy, with Chase Budinger, with Andrei Kirilenko now — some veteran guys who know how to play,”

Kevin Love on Andrei Kirilenko, Brandon Roy, Chase Budinger, Jul 27, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Marc Fleisher on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Recent media reports claimed that Kirilenko had already made up his mind about returning to the NBA and had even narrowed down his ideal choice of teams.

“I asked Andrei where all that stuff comes from and he said, 'I have no idea,'”

Marc Fleisher on Andrei Kirilenko, Nov 28, 2011. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Marc Fleisher on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Agent Marc Fleisher on ex-#UtahJazz forward Andrei Kirilenko's recent injury:

“I talked to him about 45 minutes after it happened. He told me he did not suffer a concussion. He said he broke his nose and had some bruises.”

Marc Fleisher on Andrei Kirilenko, Nov 21, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Blatt on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
David Blatt on Kirilenko:

“Have you ever been a horse trainer? Andrei is like a beautiful, wild horse. He’s best when he’s roaming around and running free. We ask him to play within the system, but honestly his best moments are when he’s doing what his heart and his instincts are telling him to do. Most of his great plays, they come not from the structure, but from the mind and the beautiful kind of talent he has. The lucky thing is that’s he’s not a selfish man, he is not a greedy player, he plays for the team.”

David Blatt on Andrei Kirilenko, Sep 15, 2011. Source: SheridanHoops.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
Although other teams might covet Kirilenko’s contract for salary cap purposes, Jazz general managerKevin O’Connor hints he’s not inclined to trade Kirilenko during the season.

“The way Andrei has played for us in the past and the way he played in the preseason, he’s a real key to our team,”

Kevin O'Connor on Andrei Kirilenko, Oct 23, 2010. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Andrei Kirilenko
item.description:
O'Connor on Kirilenko:

“I hope Andrei can play the way he played before he got hurt. ...All indications are the guy's had a good summer.”

Kevin O'Connor on Andrei Kirilenko, Sep 15, 2010. Source: Twitter.
